name: Stonerope
body:
Price 5,000 gp; Aura faint transmutation; CL 5; Weight 10 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

This 50-foot-long coil of hemp rope is of dwarven make. When the command word is spoken, the rope becomes stone in whatever shape it was in when the command word was spoken. If used for restraints while in its stone form, the rope acts like manacles for the purposes of the Escape Artist DC. The rope returns to its original form if the second command word is spoken. If the rope is broken in either form it is destroyed.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 2,500 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item, stone shape
